content.headline: Volunteering with BNMS
content.subheadline: Share your expertise, support the profession and help shape the future of nuclear medicine.

content.html:
Volunteers play a vital role in the success of the British Nuclear Medicine Society.

Whether supporting conferences, contributing to professional guidance or helping to shape future meetings, volunteers bring valuable expertise, enthusiasm and experience to the Society.

There are opportunities for members at every stage of their career to contribute, develop new skills and expand their professional networks.

content.body: Gain valuable experience, build confidence and develop new professional and leadership skills.
content.heading: Develop your skills

content.body: Meet colleagues from across the nuclear medicine community and build lasting professional relationships.
content.heading: Expand your network

content.body: Support education, guidance and the continued development of nuclear medicine practice.
content.heading: Contribute to the profession

content.body: Help support future generations of professionals and contribute to the future of the specialty.
content.heading: Make a Difference

content.html:
Support the Annual Spring Meeting while gaining valuable experience behind the scenes at one of the UK's leading nuclear medicine conferences.

Benefits include:

  • Free conference registration.

  • Access to sessions, posters and exhibitions.

  • Volunteer training and support.

  • Networking opportunities.

  • Experience supporting a major scientific meeting.

Typical activities include registration support, assisting delegates, helping speakers and supporting conference sessions.

Contact:

Angelica Spina
angelicaspina@bnms.org.uk

BNMS has been at the forefront of guideline development for more than twenty years.

Members are invited to contribute their expertise to the development and review of guidance that supports nuclear medicine practice across the UK.

Areas may include:

  • Imaging and therapy.

  • Radiopharmacy.

  • Professional practice.

  • Quality standards.

  • Service delivery.

Most contributions are undertaken remotely.

Contact:

Charlotte Weston
charlotteweston@bnms.org.uk

BNMS welcomes volunteers to support future Autumn Meetings.

Members can:

  • Suggest meeting topics.

  • Recommend venues.

  • Support local organisation.

  • Help develop scientific programmes.

  • Volunteer to host future meetings.

Recent meetings have showcased local expertise and innovation from across the nuclear medicine community.

Contact:

meetings@bnms.org.uk

content.headline: Help shape the future of Nuclear Medicine
content.subheadline:
Whether you are a student, trainee or experienced practitioner, there are many ways to get involved with BNMS.
Volunteering provides an opportunity to develop professionally, contribute to the specialty and support the wider nuclear medicine community.
